calendar_refusal_repair.contract: A visible calendar InputContractError refuses only the affected candidate; earlier frames and the full predeclared population remain. Arbitrary implementation exceptions propagate.

repairs: candidate-local invalid-calendar refusal preserves mixed populations
projection UnicodeEncodeError becomes an input-contract refusal; implementation errors propagate

integration.ci_delta: Preserve fresh-main manifest and apply exactly the reviewed one-line calendar-suite addition.

limitations: Read receipt proves consistency and current acquisition, not authenticity or historical availability.
Replay requires the exact retained original input bundle and calendar_source_snapshot; a later path replacement cannot reconstruct it.
First covered session has unknown predecessor and refuses. Dates outside coverage refuse.
No price, volume, corporate-action, identity, finality, pilot, or authority requirement is closed by this calendar component.
The existing 900-second finality and all other Phase1 refusals remain unchanged.

projection_encoding_repair.contract: Normalize UnicodeEncodeError only when encoding the replay projection text as UTF-8 to InputContractError; preserve per-candidate refusal and earlier frames.

other_direct_encoding_check.result: Receipt and bundle digests escape text with canonical JSON before UTF-8 encoding; the byte-reader decode already normalizes UnicodeError.

projection_encoding_repair.replay_input: Valid ASCII JSON containing an escaped unpaired surrogate in projection_json.

usage.clock_policy: No CLI known-at override. Actual read completion must be visible at each candidate decision. Newly read projection bytes cannot retroactively bind earlier decisions.
usage.replay: Preserve ORIGINAL_INPUT.json and the result calendar_source_snapshot. Assign that retained snapshot to the original bundle.calendar and rerun --input-panel without --calendar-projection. Verify input_bundle_sha256 and frame snapshot_sha256 against the original result.
usage.source_policy: Only the exact reviewed Terminal projection is accepted. Updating bytes or source pins is a separate reviewed source change.
